verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de says signers complete identity verification remotely via eID or video, which is a strong ID-check method tied to its notarization workflow, and businesses can manage signers. However, nothing shows a legal-ops admin can configure or require verification levels per sensitive document. Missing for 10: per-document configurable verification requirements, SMS/OTP verification, knowledge-based authentication, documentation of how verification is enforced and recorded in the audit trail, independent corroboration.
